description.value:
Your curses reach their fullest potency. When your Curse of Objurgation target fails a saving throw against one of your maneuvers, you can spend any number of Hit Dice to amplify it, dealing 1d8 psychic damage per Hit Die spent.

Additionally, whenever anyone tries to lift a curse you've placed using something like remove curse, they must make a Wisdom or Charisma check (their choice) against your maneuver save DC; failing that check wastes the attempt along with any force or tech points spent making it.
